title: iCare Insurance — Company Profile Website
summary: Designed and developed a modern corporate website for an insurance company, making company information, products, and customer support clearly accessible.
description: Designed and developed a modern corporate website for an insurance company, featuring company overview, financial statements, insurance products, and customer support services. The site needed to present complex information clearly while maintaining a trustworthy, professional image.
problem: The insurance company needed to present many types of information — company overview, insurance products, financial statements, claims, and customer support — while still feeling clear, trustworthy, and easy to navigate for everyday users.
solution: Clear top-level navigation structure organizing content by audience need
Information architecture separating product categories from company information
Clean corporate visual style with consistent typography and color
Responsive layout for desktop and mobile users
Dedicated product category pages with easy-to-scan details
Customer support access points throughout the site
Footer link grouping for quick reference
process: Wireframe and layout design in Figma
Visual UI design and component system
Frontend implementation with Next.js and Mantine
outcome: Created a more professional and trustworthy online presence for the company
Helped users access insurance product information more easily
Improved content organization for a content-heavy corporate website
Delivered a production-ready site with clean, maintainable code
demoNote: This is a demo project. The website and all content shown here were built during my time at iCare Insurance as an internal/unreleased work product. It is displayed here solely as a portfolio reference and does not represent any currently active or publicly available service.

title: Whale Services — Company Website
summary: Designed a clean, modern company profile website for Whale Services Co., Ltd., matching their brand identity and existing deployment setup.
description: Designed a company profile website for Whale Services Co., Ltd. using Canva (to align with existing deployment and domain). The project focused on delivering a clean, on-brand website that communicated the company's services clearly.
problem: Whale Services needed a company website that clearly presented their services and established a professional online presence, while working within their existing deployment and domain setup.
solution: Clean, modern layout aligned with company brand identity
Clear service presentation with concise messaging
Designed in Figma first for review, then executed in Canva for compatibility
Simple navigation structure suitable for a small business website
process: Wireframe and layout design in Figma
Visual design with brand-consistent colors and typography
Execution in Canva to match the client's existing deployment environment
outcome: Delivered a clean company website that aligned with the client's brand
Helped the client establish a more professional online presence
Worked within client constraints to deliver a practical, usable result
